5d0779f45b:
Yusuke Godai, a man chasing his dreams, transformed by an ancient belt.

Mighty Form is Kuuga's basic and most balanced form.
b038387be7:
One of Kuuga's special forms, specialized in speed and jumping.

Its attack power is lower, so he makes up for it with the Dragon Rod.
cbc8f635cc:
One of Kuuga's special forms, with heightened senses, but it lasts only 50 seconds.

It excels at sniping foes with the Pegasus Bowgun, transformed from a gun.
d422130c97:
One of Kuuga's special forms, with overwhelmingly hard armor.

It pierces enemies with the Titan Sword, transformed from items like the Tri-Accelerator.
b301b7fe0c:
Kuuga after an electric shock unleashed his hidden power.

Its finisher, the Rising Mighty Kick, is so strong it causes huge explosions.
c37485b65f:
Dragon Form, powered up by the "golden power" gained from an electric shock.

It fights with the Rising Dragon Rod, bladed at both ends.
0d9e5ce157:
Pegasus Form, powered up by the "golden power" gained from an electric shock.

It fights with the stronger Rising Pegasus Bowgun and heightened senses.
e7f545d9b4:
Titan Form, powered up by the "golden power" gained from an electric shock.

It can dual-wield two of the stronger Rising Titan Swords.
2c20dccae2:
Kuuga strengthened further by another electric shock.

Its finisher is the two-footed Amazing Mighty Kick.
ae2600c22a:
Kuuga's strongest form, the Warrior of Terror. It can cause spontaneous combustion.

Its eyes should be black, but they turned red because Godai transformed with a pure heart.
c8466a5c62:
Shoichi Tsugami, a man with amnesia, awakened by light. He fights the Unknown, who hunt humans awakening as Agito.
Grand Form, the "Gold of the Transcendent Body", is his basic form, with the earth's power.
347e99bea4:
Agito's special form, the "Red of Transcendent Senses".

It fights with boosted power and the Flame Saber, a blade holding fire.
1aac11386b:
Agito's special form, the "Blue of the Transcendent Spirit".

It fights with swift moves and the Storm Halberd, holding the power of wind.
9e7e4c3a0b:
The trinity form Agito (Shoichi) took when he briefly regained his memory.

It uses the finishing kick Rider Shoot.
3e6a035033:
Agito's further powered-up form, with immense power.
Its finishers are the Burning Rider Punch, packed with fire, and the Burning Bomber, using the Shining Calibur in Single Mode.
ca91871bfe:
Agito's strongest form, born when Burning Form broke out of its shell in the sunlight.

It uses the Shining Rider Kick, passing through crests that appear in the air.
a50a5926f6:
Shinji Kido, a trainee reporter at the mobile news company OREJournal, contracted with the Mirror Monster Dragreder.
Using Advent Cards holding Dragreder's power, he tries to stop the Riders' fight.
d96d45ea24:
Ryuki's powered-up form, changed into with the Survive "Blazing Fire" card. He commands the likewise changed Dragranzer.
Its finisher, Dragon Fire Storm, attacks with Dragranzer in Bike Mode.
d499de172c:
Transformed by entering the code "555" in the Faiz Phone and setting it in the Faiz Driver. Mainly worn by Takumi Inui.
Its finisher is Crimson Smash, fired with the Faiz Pointer, a digital torch device, on the right leg.
8f3d79fb72:
Faiz's super-speed form, transformed with the Faiz Accel on the left wrist.

Pressing the Faiz Accel's switch lets him move at super speed for 10 seconds.
a361aa5c58:
Faiz's strongest form, changed by the Faiz Blaster.

Photon Blood covers his whole body; ordinary Orphnochs vanish at its touch.
1b8687b2ef:
Kazuma Kenzaki transforms by loading the Category A Undead's Rouse Card into his belt.
Rouse Card combos give him powers; his finisher Lightning Sonic combines Kick, Thunder and Mach.
01d11bf824:
Blade's powered-up form, reached by loading the Queen card into the Rouse Absorber and rousing the Jack card.

He can spread the wings on his back to fly.
d9c24b9725:
Blade's strongest form, transformed with the King of Spades card.

Fused with 13 Undead, he wields unimaginable power.
85e2423b50:
Warriors who trained body and mind to master the transformation called Oni. They defeat the Makamou by driving purifying sounds into them.
Hibiki, a veteran who has fought for over 15 years, transforms into him.
9a994bed1c:
A form reached through further training to fight the summer Makamou.

With Ongeki Da: Shakunetsu Shinku, he wipes out hordes of human-sized Makamou.
a9e28c00fd:
The strongest form, wearing the Disk Animals as armor, changed by the power of the Armed Saber.
The Armed Saber turns his voice into sonic waves that sweep enemies away.
51508966ef:
Soji Tendo, a genius who calls himself "the man who walks the path of heaven and rules over all", transforms with the Kabuto Zecter.
Masked Form is his first form, with strong armor.
8b8182fbcd:
Kabuto's basic form, reached by Casting Off from Masked Form.

In this form he can use Clock Up to move at super speed.
3986344152:
Kabuto's strongest form, evolved with the Hyper Zecter.
With the Perfect Zecter he can use Hyper Clock Up, which even transcends space and time.
a436590d7e:
Ryotaro Nogami, a Singularity unaffected by time, transforms.
Sword Form is reached when his Imagin ally Momotaros possesses him; true to Momotaros, it excels at rough fighting.
556c9f893c:
Another Den-O form, reached when Urataros possesses Ryotaro. He fights with the DenGasher in Rod Mode, reeling enemies in.

Its finisher is the Den Rider Kick.
2672e5cdca:
Another Den-O form, reached when Kintaros possesses Ryotaro. He fights with the DenGasher in Axe Mode and sumo moves.

Its finisher is the Dynamic Chop.
630851aa47:
Another Den-O form, reached when Ryutaros possesses Ryotaro.
He toys with foes with breakdance-like moves.

Its finisher is the Wild Shot.
cdb9d636db:
The form Ryotaro takes with the DenKamen Sword, with Ryotaro himself in control.

Using the Imagin's power in the sword, his finisher is the Densha Giri he named himself.
018c902dd1:
The "all-in" form, where Momotaros, Urataros, Kintaros and Ryutaros all possess Ryotaro through the phone-shaped K-Taros.
He uses the Boisterous Kick and Boisterous Punch.
5e0ea8d965:
A special Den-O form reached when the Imagin Sieg possesses Ryotaro.
He splits the DenGasher in two and fights elegantly.
Its finisher is the Royal Smash.
9a542b2ea0:
The "super all-in" form, where five Imagin including Sieg possess Ryotaro.

He defeats enemies with the finisher Super Boisterous Kick.
5cb8ae7955:
Wataru Kurenai, half human and half Fangire, transforms.
Kiva Form is Kiva's basic form; its finisher Darkness Moon Break is unleashed by opening the Hell's Gate restraint on his right leg.
5a16309ef5:
A special Kiva form reached by gripping the beast sword Garuru Saber in the left hand.

He tears enemies apart with the Garuru Saber, moving like a wild beast.
21b8cf2fe5:
A special Kiva form reached by gripping the sea gun Basshaa Magnum in the right hand.

He excels underwater, attacking with bullets of water.
234e1ce670:
A special Kiva form reached by gripping the iron hammer Dogga Hammer with both hands.

He has astonishing strength, smashing enemies with one blow of the hammer.
55dc28b846:
A special form born when Kivat, who caught a cold, summoned all three Arms Monsters at once and fused them with Kiva.

It excels in speed, firepower and defense.
2ac21b025f:
Kiva's true form, with every restraint and Catena holding back his armor released.

He fights with the Zanvat Sword and the two-legged Emperor Moon Break.
fb5da57909:
Tsukasa Kadoya, a young man who lost his memory, transforms with the Decadriver and Rider Cards: the Destroyer of Worlds.
With Rider Cards he can turn into past Kamen Riders.
013e6f13fc:
Decade's form reached with the K-Touch and the Complete card.

It excels at Final Attack Ride, summoning nine Riders' strongest forms to attack together.
7be0594b34:
An even stronger form, where every card on Complete Form's chest shows the nine Riders' strongest forms.
It can force the other nine Riders into their strongest forms.
01fba7f693:
Decade after accepting himself as the Destroyer of Worlds, his face turned demonic.

He can use other Riders' abilities without changing into them.
76cfe028cb:
Two-in-one Rider formed by detective Shotaro Hidari and his partner Philip, guarding Futo from Gaia Memory crime.
Cyclone Joker (Cyclone and Joker) is the basic form, great in close combat.
c275633ae0:
One of W's forms, using the Heat and Metal Memories. He fights with the Metal Shaft infused with fire.

Its Maximum Drive finisher is Metal Branding.
e15e8cf3a8:
One of W's forms, using the Luna and Trigger Memories. The Luna Memory lets him bend shots from the Trigger Magnum.

Its Maximum Drive is Trigger Full Burst.
50d3e05db2:
W's strongest form, where Shotaro's and Philip's minds and bodies become one through the Extreme Memory.
Linked directly to the Earth's vast database, he downloads any data he needs in battle.
3706e18ba7:
The ultimate form CycloneJokerXtreme became, carried by Futo's wind and the people's feelings.

It flies with the wings on its back and fights with the finisher Golden Extreme.
b9a2c2edde:
W's special form led by Philip, using the dinosaur Fang Memory and Joker Memory.
Flicking the Fang Memory arms his body with sharp blades.
Its Maximum Drive is Fang Streiser.
3390700c7b:
Shotaro Hidari's solo Kamen Rider form, using the Joker Memory and Lost Driver.

He excels at hand-to-hand combat, with the Rider Punch and Rider Kick as finishers.
68faef0bca:
Kamen Rider OOO's basic combo, transformed by Eiji Hino with the Taka, Tora and Batta Medals.
A combo form that tires him less, with good balance. Its finisher, the Tatoba Kick, changes his legs into Batta Legs to kick enemies away.
a121173d85:
An insect combo form using the Kuwagata, Kamakiri and Batta Medals.

It excels at lightning from the Kuwagata Head and splitting into 50 clones.
fe326bbf11:
A feline combo form using the Lion, Tora and Cheetah Medals.
It can use the powerful heat ray Lio Diaz and Gush Cross, slashing in an X with the Tora Claws.
03ec7bff06:
A heavyweight combo form using the Sai, Gorilla and Zou Medals.

Its specialty, Sagouzo Impact, pulls enemies in with gravity and slams them with both fists.
a3b7dfd73d:
A bird combo using the Taka, Kujaku and Condor Medals; his head becomes the Taka Head Brave.
He flies with the Kujaku Wings and unleashes Prominence Drop, kicking with clawed feet.
bc17d86641:
An aquatic combo form using the Shachi, Unagi and Tako Medals. It swims freely underwater.

Its specialty is Octo Banish, a kick that spins the Tako Legs like a drill.
e92b3bf458:
The strongest combo, using the purple dinosaur Medals: Ptera, Tricera and Tyranno.
He loads Cell Medals into the MedaGabryu, a weapon pulled from the ground, to fire the destruction beam Strain Doom.
cf4c72706c:
OOO's special form using the orange Cobra, Kame and Wani Medals.

Its finisher is Warning Ride, sliding along the ground to kick foes.
cb4342def0:
A form transformed with three Medals from the future: Super Taka, Super Tora and Super Batta.

The future Medals' power keeps him safe from attacks that move through time and space.
be062d0aa8:
Gentaro Kisaragi, new at Amanogawa High, uses the Fourze Driver to become a Kamen Rider who can fight in space.
With the Astro Switches and the Kamen Rider Club, he guards the school from the Zodiarts.
895d9e63ed:
A special form Fourze reaches with the Elek Switch.

He attacks with various electric moves using the Billy the Rod.
d651a53cf7:
A special form Fourze reaches with the Fire Switch.

Besides fire attacks with the Hee-Hackgun, he can fire extinguisher to put out fires.
4854134c32:
A powered-up form Fourze reaches by splitting and inserting the Magnet Switch.
He uses the Rider Super Electromagnetic Bomber, combining his shoulder cannons like a U-shaped magnet.
5462691ca1:
Fourze's strongest form, born from all 40 Astro Switches and his bonds with the Kamen Rider Club.
He combines the Switches and uses the Rider Super Galaxy Finish from the Barizun Sword.
c42763b944:
A special Fourze form using the Rocket Switch Super-1, with big rockets on both arms.

He uses the Rider Spinning Crusher, piercing enemies by spinning at high speed.
